method: Actual visual inspection of all three full viewport screenshots and four sampled frames of the encoded GIF; not a frame-by-frame movie review.
findings: Consistent CopyPaste blue/neutral brand, readable service evidence and distinct green/red badges.
Actual transition and signature-proof dialog visible; original MP4 is recommended for small evidence text.
The mobile screenshot shows the current status and service facts; additional source/history content is below the captured viewport.
Only isolated synthetic records and public business identifiers/digests are visible; no passwords, MFA input, private keys or tokens.
